disability_types.name: Visual Impairment
disability_types.description_text: Complete or partial loss of vision, including blindness and low vision

disability_types.name: Hearing Impairment
disability_types.description_text: Complete or partial loss of hearing, including deafness

disability_types.name: Locomotor Disability
disability_types.description_text: Disability of bones, joints, or muscles leading to movement restriction

disability_types.name: Intellectual Disability
disability_types.description_text: Significantly impaired intellectual functioning and adaptive behavior

disability_types.name: Multiple Disabilities
disability_types.description_text: Combination of two or more disabilities

benefits.name: Disability Pension
benefits.description_text: Monthly pension for persons with disabilities

benefits.name: Scholarship
benefits.description_text: Educational scholarship for students with disabilities

benefits.name: Assistive Device
benefits.description_text: Financial assistance for purchase of assistive devices and appliances

benefits.name: Skill Development Training
benefits.description_text: Training program assistance for skill development

benefits.name: Health Insurance
benefits.description_text: Health insurance coverage for persons with disabilities

benefits.name: Travel Concession
benefits.description_text: Concession in train and bus fares

eligibility.name: Basic Eligibility
eligibility.description_text: Person with 40% or more disability, age 18 or above

eligibility.name: Below Poverty Line Eligibility
eligibility.description_text: Person with 40% or more disability, below poverty line

eligibility.name: Student Eligibility
eligibility.description_text: Student with disability studying in recognized institution

eligibility.name: Niramaya Eligibility
eligibility.description_text: Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, MR and Multiple Disabilities

eligibility.name: UDID Eligibility
eligibility.description_text: Any person with specified disability under RPwD Act 2016

documents.name: Disability Certificate
documents.description_text: Issued by authorized medical board certifying disability percentage

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description_text: Government issued identity proof with unique identification number

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.description_text: Proof of family income issued by revenue department

documents.name: Medical Report
documents.description_text: Detailed medical assessment report from authorized doctor

application_processes.name: Railway Concession Process
steps: Get concession certificate from Government Doctor

government_bodies.name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.description_text: Monthly pension of ₹3000 for persons with 40% or more disability belonging to BPL households.

schemes.name: ADIP Scheme (Aids and Appliances)
schemes.description_text: Financial assistance up to ₹25000 for purchase/fitting of aids and appliances like wheelchairs, hearing aids.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship
schemes.description_text: Scholarship for disabled students in classes 9 and 10.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship
schemes.description_text: Scholarship for disabled students in higher education.

schemes.name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
schemes.description_text: Grant-in-aid to NGOs for rehabilitation services.

schemes.name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card
schemes.description_text: A single identification card for persons with disabilities valid across India. It eliminates the need for maintaining multiple documents.

schemes.name: Niramaya Health Insurance
schemes.description_text: Health insurance scheme providing cover up to ₹1.0 Lakh for persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities.

schemes.name: Railway Fare Concession
schemes.description_text: Concession in railway fares for persons with disabilities (Orthopaedic, Visual, Hearing, Mental Retardation). Discount ranges from 50% to 75%.
